weeks.note: RACE WEEK +1. Four days COMPLETE rest, then two 30 min walks. Nothing else. The research band for 70.3 recovery is 14-28 days, and the failure mode is starting the next block on the fitness you had before the taper.

sessions.label: COMPLETE REST. Walk if you want to move.

weeks.note: Zone 2 ONLY, HR under 145. No quality of any kind. Ten to twenty-four days of easy is the protocol; training hard here only lengthens recovery.

sessions.label: LONG RUN 5 km, HR under 155. Aerobic volume is the lever - the fastest runners get there on Zone 1 km, not on intervals.
Strength UPPER - push and pull as one session, 40 min. Does not touch the legs.
Easy run 3.5 km, HR under 155. Genuinely easy - this is the km that builds the engine.

Strength LOWER - HEAVY, 40 min. Trap-bar deadlift 4 x 3 at 88-92% 1RM, Bulgarian split squat 3 x 5/leg, calf raises 3 x 8 loaded. COMPLEX PAIRING: 5 box jumps or 20 m bounds within 2 min of each heavy set. Heavy strength improves running economy; plyometrics alone do not. Keep at least 3 h between this and any run - that is the interval the concurrent-training work says clears molecular interference. LOWER-LEG AND FOOT, 5 min: tibialis raises 3 x 15-20, heel walks 2 x 20 m, short-foot holds 3 x 30 s/side.
REST. Every week. Non-negotiable.
Easy run 3.5 km, HR under 155. Genuinely easy - this is the km that builds the engine.
